name: open_app
description: Open an installed application. macOS app names are ALWAYS in English, e.g. Terminal, Notes, Safari, Mail, Preview, Calendar, Messages, Music, Maps, Photos, Reminders, Calculator, Figma. Never use German app names like Terminalfenster or Notizen. If the user asks for a WEBSITE (google.com, wikipedia.org), call open_url instead.

name: open_url
description: Open a website in the browser. Use this for ANY website request like 'open the website google.com', even if the transcript spells the domain oddly (e.g. 'Google Punkt com' or 'Google Com').

name: take_screenshot
description: Save a screenshot to the Desktop

name: say_text
description: Speak text aloud with the Mac voice. Use when asked to say, speak or announce something (e.g. 'say hello' or 'sag hallo')

name: open_settings_pane
description: Open a System Settings pane. Use when the user asks where to find or how to change a setting, e.g. 'where can I see the battery status?' or 'wo sehe ich den Akkustand' -> pane 'battery'. Panes: battery, wifi, display, sound, appearance, notifications, storage, keyboard, mouse, bluetooth, network, privacy, softwareupdate, desktop, language, date, users, passwords, general.

name: get_todays_events
description: Show today's calendar events. Use when the user asks what appointments they have today (e.g. 'welchen Termin habe ich heute?'). Opens the Calendar app and speaks the answer. No arguments.

name: find_on_page
description: Scroll to and highlight text on the website currently shown in the frontmost browser window. Use when the user asks where to find something on the open webpage, e.g. 'wo finde ich die Adresse?'. The browser window must be in front.

name: add_reminder
description: Add an item to a reminders list, e.g. a shopping list ('ich muss noch Milch kaufen' -> list 'Einkauf', text 'Milch'). Creates the list if it does not exist. Default list name is 'Einkauf'.

name: remember
description: Store a fact, preference or todo in long-term memory for later recall, e.g. 'merke dir mein Zug fährt um 7:15'.
